description: Canonical point-role vocabulary shared by Open-FDD, open-hvac-edge and nf-hvac-functional-test. Every role is an ASHRAE 223P property pattern with a QUDT unit and one Haystack 4 binding. See README.md.

derivation.rule: role = '_'.join(tokens), where tokens are the lexicon tokens of the s223 basis fields in slot order, then the suffix; empty tokens are dropped, and a token is dropped when all of its words already occur in the token kept just before it.

slot_notes.scope: Containing equipment, space or external source the pattern is pinned to (s223:contains / s223:hasProperty on a Zone). Omitted when the pattern applies to the equipment the consumer is assessing.
slot_notes.equipment_role: s223:hasRole on the equipment that has the property.
slot_notes.equipment_medium: s223:hasMedium of that equipment's connection points, when the pattern constrains it.
slot_notes.equipment: The s223 equipment class that has the property (s223:hasProperty), for equipment properties such as status, command and position.
slot_notes.roles: s223:Role-* of the connection point where the property is observed, or set on the property with s223:hasAspect; flow roles first, then function roles.
slot_notes.connection_point: Used only when roles is empty: the s223 connection point class.
slot_notes.qualifier: Extension terms only (ext:*). Empty for pure 223P roles.
slot_notes.quantity_kind: qudt:hasQuantityKind. For an enumerated alarm status, the quantity kind of the quantifiable property it is linked to with s223:hasAlarmStatus.
slot_notes.aspects: s223:hasAspect values other than roles, in aspect_order.

derivation.suffix_exception: A QuantifiableActuatableProperty with s223:Aspect-Setpoint, s223:Aspect-Maximum or s223:Aspect-Minimum takes no suffix: the aspect already says it is a configured value.

s223:Electricity-AC.why: The QUDT quantity kinds ElectricCurrent, ElectricPower and ElectricEnergy already name the medium.

quantitykind:DimensionlessRatio.why: A dimensionless ratio names no physical quantity; the aspect (Binary-Position) or constituent (CO2) names it.

s223:Binary-OnOff.why: Binary kinds give the value shape (On/Off, Open/Closed, True/False), not the subject.

s223:Binary-Logical.why: Binary kinds give the value shape (On/Off, Open/Closed, True/False), not the subject.

ext:Mixed.closest: s223:OutletConnectionPoint of the s223:Junction where outdoor-air-intake and return air streams merge
ext:Mixed.why: 223P has no role for the mixed-air plenum; Haystack 4 uses the duct section marker mixed.

ext:Preheat.closest: s223:HeatingCoil (first coil in the air stream) with s223:Role-Heating
ext:Preheat.why: 223P has no role that orders coils in the air stream; preheat separates the first heating coil from the main one.

ext:WeatherService.closest: s223:hasExternalReference on a property of s223:Fluid-Air outside the building
ext:WeatherService.why: A weather-service value is not a site sensor; 223P has no class for an external weather source.

ext:Speed.why: The g36 shape defines the speed command without a distinguishing term; the open223 example models use a draft EnumerationKind-Speed aspect that is not in the published ontology.

ext:ResetRequest.why: Guideline 36 reset requests are a control-sequence count; 223P has no term for them.

ext:StaticPressureResetRequest.why: Guideline 36 static-pressure reset requests from terminal units; 223P has no term for them.

ext:LoadSatisfied.why: A building-level aggregate computed by the rules; 223P has no term for it.

ext:Total.closest: s223:Function hasOutput summing terminal-unit s223:QuantifiableObservableProperty values
ext:Total.why: An aggregate across terminal units; 223P has no aggregation term.

ext:Mode-Test.why: 223P has no HVAC operating-mode value set; the functional-test mode values are site-defined.

ext:Mode-MaximumCooling.why: 223P has no HVAC operating-mode value set; drives served terminal units to their cooling maximum airflow.

ext:Mode-Purge.why: 223P has no HVAC operating-mode value set; purge (flush) opens terminal units to flush the space. Haystack 4 defines the marker purge.

ingest_conversions.note: A source that reports a ratio as 0-1 (unit:FRACTION or unit:UNITLESS) is scaled to percent at ingest.

custom_markers.smoke: Haystack 4 has no smoke marker. Required with alarm and sensor on a duct smoke detector point.
custom_markers.test: Haystack 4 has no test marker. Marks the operating-mode command that puts an air handler in functional-test mode.
custom_markers.mode: Haystack 4 has no generic mode marker (hvacMode is the current HVAC mode, not a command). Marks site mode commands.
custom_markers.request: Haystack 4 has no request marker. Marks Guideline 36 reset-request counts.
custom_markers.satisfied: Haystack 4 has no satisfied marker. Marks the derived load-satisfied flags.
custom_markers.preheat: Haystack 4 has no preheat marker. Marks points of the first heating coil in the air stream.

binding_rules: Read NF's class attr and its markers attr (one comma-separated string); split markers on commas and trim. Also accept a tags array and marker-valued attrs.

A point carries exactly one function marker: sensor, sp or cmd. A role whose markers include one of them never binds a point that carries another; a role whose markers include none forbids the two it does not accept.

A point binds a role when its NF class is in haystack.classes, or when it carries every marker in haystack.markers (or every marker of one haystack.alt_markers set) and custom_markers; in both cases it must carry none of haystack.forbid.

binding_scope says which point is meant: own = a point of the equipment being assessed; fed_by_air_handling_unit = a point of the air handler named by the equipment's airRef; aggregate = a point of the equipment that sums its terminal units; weather = a point of the site weather equipment; derived = computed by the consumer, never bound from tags.

haystack.equip_markers, when present, must be carried by the parent equipment (equipRef). haystack.equip_forbid, when present, must be absent from that parent. Equipment markers never flow down to points. A shared NF class is a binding collision when those parent constraints can both hold.

haystack.optional never decides whether a point binds. When several points of one equipment bind the same role, the point carrying the most optional markers wins; a remaining tie leaves the role unbound and reported.
If a point still matches several roles, the role whose markers are a strict superset wins; any remaining tie leaves the point unbound and reported. List order never decides.
An unknown label never becomes a role. An unbound required input makes the consumer's rule or step not applicable.

writable_policy: writable is a ceiling, never a grant. A consumer may write a point only when the role says model, the site model marks the point writable, and the consumer's own runtime confirmation passes. never means no consumer writes it to a field point. Open-FDD writes only its own result points and the weather_service_* points it creates.

ambiguous_legacy_names.outside_air_damper_position: Older vocabularies used this for the command (rules bundle, UI contract, edge) and for the feedback (functional test). Resolve by the point's function marker: cmd -> outdoor_air_intake_damper_position_command, sensor -> outdoor_air_intake_damper_position.
ambiguous_legacy_names.cooling_valve_position: Canonical feedback role. The unreleased rules bundle used it for the command; values stored under it from a cmd point belong to cooling_valve_position_command.
ambiguous_legacy_names.heating_valve_position: Canonical feedback role. The unreleased rules bundle used it for the command; values stored under it from a cmd point belong to heating_valve_position_command.

Run proof: derived from the equipment's own status or command, or the equipment feeding it (sql/fdd/run_proof.json).

Haystack 4 has no supply marker; the supply fan is the discharge fan. A boiler run sensor is boiler_operating_status.
